passages.text: Son veintitrés con cuarenta. ¿Tiene tarjeta de cliente? Con ella hoy tiene un diez por ciento de descuento en la fruta. Las bolsas cuestan diez céntimos cada una.
passages.en: That's twenty-three forty. Do you have a loyalty card? With it you get ten percent off fruit today. Bags cost ten cents each.
passages.question: Which statement is true?
passages.answer: With a loyalty card, fruit is ten percent cheaper today.
wrong: The total is thirty-two euros forty.
Everything is ten percent off, card or not.

passages.text: São vinte e três e quarenta. Tem cartão de cliente? Com o cartão hoje tem dez por cento de desconto na fruta. Os sacos custam dez cêntimos cada.
passages.en: That's twenty-three forty. Do you have a loyalty card? With the card you get ten percent off fruit today. Bags cost ten cents each.
passages.question: Which statement is true?
passages.answer: With a loyalty card, fruit is ten percent cheaper today.
wrong: The total is thirty-two euros forty.
Everything is ten percent off, card or not.

passages.text: La leche sin lactosa está en el pasillo siete, al lado de los yogures. Esta semana hay oferta: la segunda unidad a mitad de precio. Las cestas están en la entrada, junto a las puertas.
passages.en: Lactose-free milk is in aisle seven, next to the yoghurts. This week there's an offer: the second one at half price. The baskets are at the entrance, by the doors.
passages.question: What's the offer?
passages.answer: The second one at half price.
wrong: Two for the price of one.

passages.text: ¿Quién es el último? Ah, usted va después de mí. Aquí se coge número en la máquina, pero hoy está rota, así que vamos por orden. El pescado lo limpian gratis si se lo pide.
passages.en: Who's last? Ah, you're after me. Here you take a number from the machine, but today it's broken, so we go in order. They'll clean the fish for free if you ask.
passages.question: How does the queue work today?
passages.answer: In order of arrival, because the ticket machine is broken.
wrong: Take a number from the machine.

passages.text: Quem é o último? Ah, o senhor vai a seguir a mim. Aqui tira-se senha na máquina, mas hoje está avariada, por isso vamos por ordem. O peixe amanham-no de graça se pedir.
passages.en: Who's last? Ah, you're after me. Here you take a number from the machine, but today it's broken, so we go in order. They'll clean the fish for free if you ask.
passages.question: How does the queue work today?
passages.answer: In order of arrival, because the ticket machine is broken.
wrong: Take a number from the machine.

passages.text: No pasa nada, es que la báscula ha detectado algo. Ya está. Para el vino necesito ver su documento, es obligatorio. Y la próxima vez puede usar la caja de al lado, que acepta efectivo.
passages.en: It's fine; the scale detected something. There, done. For the wine I need to see your ID; it's mandatory. And next time you can use the till next door, which takes cash.
passages.question: Why does the assistant need your ID?

passages.text: Não faz mal, a balança detetou alguma coisa. Pronto, já está. Para o vinho preciso de ver o seu documento, é obrigatório. E da próxima vez pode usar a caixa ao lado, que aceita dinheiro.
